new_tasks.name: Review successor arguments, information needs and stopping rules
steps: Analyze each failed or conditional predecessor without rerunning saved seeds.
Derive what additional information or assumptions could change identifiability and uncertainty.
Specify go/no-go conditions before any new qualification and check finite-screen power.

criteria.statement: R02/R03/R04/R05/E01 and live evaluation each have an explicit obstruction, candidate remedy, matched comparator, stop rule and evidence requirement.
Candidate derivations distinguish observable or obtainable inputs from oracle quantities and do not claim solved generalizations.
Qualification separates theoretical coverage, Monte Carlo uncertainty, width, availability, scope and authentic bank usefulness.

new_tasks.failure_action: Preserve failures; do not narrow the claim or change final data to manufacture success. Record the exact obstruction and continue other eligible work.

new_tasks.name: Research a valid persistent-map/calendar/audit successor
steps: Derive finite or justified asymptotic joint uncertainty under persistent identities, independent calendar information and estimated audit error. A supplied covariance oracle is a diagnostic, not a replacement.
Review mathematical and information feasibility; refuse final-study registration while design blockers remain.
Test rank/near-rank, pair/date/gold growth, calendar persistence and adverse inclusion; preserve previous failing regimes or leave them explicitly unqualified.
Freeze a fresh fixed design, retain all requests, and compare the successor with every predecessor acceptance obligation.

criteria.statement: One explicit joint sampling law accounts for all pair/date/gold cross terms and rates.
Independent-origin and complete-truth limiting cases match separate references.
Fresh registered evidence meets its scoped uncertainty rule and retains the earlier undercoverage and new failure cases.
Endogenous maps and unknown/noisy selection remain refused without identified new information.
A bound successor review approves the argument, observable inputs, fresh protocol and unchanged original obligation; new scope restrictions remain unqualified for the excluded regime.

new_tasks.name: Research estimated loggers and policy selection with hidden states

Review mathematical and information feasibility; refuse final-study registration while design blockers remain.
Compare supplied and estimated loggers, frozen and learned policies, weak overlap and hidden-state nonidentification; no unknown-optimum claim from fixed-policy evaluation.
Freeze a fresh fixed design, retain all requests, and compare the successor with every predecessor acceptance obligation.

criteria.statement: Identification matches the fitted likelihood and available audit/logger information.

Fresh registered policy-value evidence meets the declared uncertainty target and rejects leakage/unsupported regimes.
Fixed-policy evaluation and unknown optimal-policy inference have separate dispositions; the latter stays open without an argument.
A bound successor review approves the argument, observable inputs, fresh protocol and unchanged original obligation; new scope restrictions remain unqualified for the excluded regime.

new_tasks.name: Research useful graph-to-effect sets with explicit added information
steps: Construct an observed-law confidence set over graphs and parameters with valid numerical outer bounds; state exactly which measurements or interventions exclude equivalent effects.
Review mathematical and information feasibility; refuse final-study registration while design blockers remain.
Keep latent/weak-relevance and temporal failures; measure graph retention, effect coverage, finite availability and useful width jointly.
Freeze a fresh fixed design, retain all requests, and compare the successor with every predecessor acceptance obligation.

criteria.statement: Graph-class retention and effect-set coverage are argued jointly; a selected graph is not called a confidence region.
Certified bounds contain the exact small-class oracle; numerical timeout is distinguished from nonidentification.
Fresh registered evidence meets scoped retention/effect rules and retains unrestricted/disconnected effects.
Experimental/scientific exclusions are required for observationally equivalent effects; arbitrary PAG confidence remains an explicit generalization.
A bound successor review approves the argument, observable inputs, fresh protocol and unchanged original obligation; new scope restrictions remain unqualified for the excluded regime.

new_tasks.name: Research dependent learners with justified remainder control
steps: Derive learner-specific rates, independent-pilot or separated-block arguments and weak-IV inversion before choosing a final learner and design.
Review mathematical and information feasibility; refuse final-study registration while design blockers remain.
Retain high-dimension, larger-support and nonlinear adverse cases; never tune final penalties or confidence levels from qualification outcomes.

Registered valid/adverse evidence meets the stated inference rule; prediction gains alone do not qualify it.
Approximation and scale limits remain attached to every output; no arbitrary-learner guarantee.

Target-platform time/memory/availability and resume/cancel/recovery meet predeclared owner criteria, including recorded sandbox limits.
Owner acceptance and actual workloads are bound; local tests are not relabeled bank-scale evidence.

new_tasks.name: Run a genuine held-out live LLM and agent evaluation

Register independent held-out mechanisms and compare data-only, LLM-only, retrieval, hybrid and expert workflows.
Include label/counterfactual/temporal/latent ablations, semantic and effect loss, abstention, repeated runs and complete costs.

revised_unresolved_tasks.name: Make the bounded product and investment decision
steps: Reconcile all qualification gates and remaining generalizations against the agreed bounded product contract.
Obtain the sponsor's signed accept/reject/defer decision, operating owner and approved release scope.
Deliver a final integrated technical and sponsor PDF with exact evidence identities and any rejected uses.
Assess the exact I02 delivery manifest and its three repair areas. Retain the legacy I01 lineage reference; bind assessed_current_release and scope_release_sha256 to I02.
Bind predecessor-to-successor scope comparisons. Any excluded regime remains an open gap; a narrower investment proposal requires a separately reviewed sponsor scope decision.

criteria.statement: All bounded capability, independent, bank, platform/interface and economic gates pass for the claimed scope.
The sponsor's institutional decision and operating obligations are signed; unrestricted universal inference is not asserted.
Signed acceptance assesses I02's current manifest and the enlarged software, LLM/agent and integration scope; I01-only acceptance is insufficient.
The declared enlarged scope passes reviewed scientific/platform successors and an actual live evaluation; preserved negative/inconclusive predecessors are not rewritten.

revised_unresolved_tasks.failure_action: A rejected or deferred investment is an honest institutional outcome, not a deployed product. Do not erase failed gap gates to obtain a positive decision.

new_inputs.owner_role: Named independent adjudicators and rubric owner

gaps.name: Identity information
gaps.route: Known extra-information route; old count-only singular experiment remains nonidentifying.
gaps.current: R01 scoped added-information screen passes; R02 persistent pair/calendar/gold law fails; authentic inclusion and independent-calendar supply unverified.
gaps.remaining_generalization: No universal identity/ownership reconstruction from ambiguous records alone.

gaps.name: Nonlinear private states and optimal policies
gaps.route: Model-specific research; no general solution is known.
gaps.current: R03 selected nonlinear fixed-policy value passes valid synthetic cells with truthful audits and supplied logger; unknown optimum and estimated logger remain open.
gaps.remaining_generalization: General nonlinear/POMDP and unknown-optimum inference remain distinct open research.

gaps.name: Learned latent temporal graphs
gaps.route: Research plus new information when effects are observationally equivalent.
gaps.current: R04-v3 retains true graph under valid finite class but whole-line/weak relevance and finite availability fail; arbitrary temporal PAG confidence open.
gaps.remaining_generalization: No arbitrary latent temporal graph confidence guarantee.

gaps.name: Assignment, semantic and audit truth
gaps.route: Requires authentic scientific information; code cannot infer truth from declarations.
gaps.current: False exogeneity, inclusion, label and exclusion assumptions fail; no bank-certified assignment, ownership, inclusion or gold truth.
gaps.remaining_generalization: Universal semantic truth and endogenous/many-to-many reconstruction are not promised.

gaps.name: Persistent maps and shared calendars
gaps.route: Selected derivation exists; a unified useful law needs further research.
gaps.current: R02 joint persistent map/calendar/gold study is negative in key finite regimes; stronger variance law or more independent information needed.
gaps.remaining_generalization: Arbitrary dependence and degenerate projections need separate arguments.

gaps.name: Dependent learners and complete computation
gaps.route: Known qualification workflow; each new learner still needs a proof/rate argument.
gaps.current: R05-v2 learner remains negative at high dimension/support; E01-v2 full local linked streaming and recovery pass but arbitrary learner and target computation open.
gaps.remaining_generalization: No arbitrary learner or unrestricted out-of-core guarantee.

gaps.name: Platform scale and recovery
gaps.route: Known engineering and target-platform trial route.
gaps.current: E01-v2 real local single-process fault recovery passes; no measured consistent streaming advantage, bank scale, multi-host or service-level acceptance.
gaps.remaining_generalization: Qualification is specific to accepted platform/workload/service requirements.

gaps.name: Independent review and institutional acceptance
gaps.route: Known external review/validation/adoption route; people and inputs absent.
gaps.current: Only author integration and local fixtures; independent scientific review, authentic bank validation and accepted interfaces absent.
gaps.remaining_generalization: No inferred user/bank approval or sibling integration.

gaps.name: Calibrated usable precision
gaps.route: Research; no successful universal correction is known.
gaps.current: R01/R03 selected grids pass but R02/R04/R05 fail material regimes; useful bank precision and uniform guarantees absent.
gaps.remaining_generalization: Finite-grid evidence cannot establish uniform validity over all models.

gaps.name: Economic usefulness
gaps.route: Known measurement/design route; authentic thresholds, prices and held-out value absent.
gaps.current: Synthetic values/widths and local workloads known; bank precision/loss thresholds, actual prices, held-out decision value and ROI absent.
gaps.remaining_generalization: No claim that more pilot rows or audits are cost-effective in a bank.

scope_rule: All original substantive obligations remain. Successors replace terminal attempt gates, not scientific standards. Negative predecessor evidence remains immutable.
